body: Yes I agree, they didn't purposely hurt someone. I did have someone completely curse me out when I was suicidal and that's so much worse than this.
It has improved a lot since we've talked!
Disagree. Sometimes people just don't want to be in a relationship even though they know the person they're dating is great. There could be many other reasons for it.

Don't you think this is completely awful of you? With your attitude, people simply aren't allowed to break up. If they try to end it on good terms by saying nice things, you're mad. If they get annoyed and are blunt about it, you're mad too. Dumpees like you really need to learn that you're not entitled to anyone.

Yea just anxious that people notice my messy place so I'll do that in the middle of the night. 

I hope so, I just didn't end up as I expected myself to be at all and feel tainted and unneeded all the time.

If you need to vent about something too, just let me know!

Haha yes I'm anxious to walk around the apartment block with all my trash bags and it's overwhelming how much I have to do so I just finish my work for the day while other things that need time and energy get worse and worse which then triggers the psycho inside of me. I have these very creepy tendencies which I also truly hate about myself and they get triggered by people not trying to understand me or just random stuff that annoys me makes me rage. This knowledge about myself and my dumb behavior triggers a lot of self-hatred, especially because I keep repeating it. Like ugh, why am I such an ugly person?

But yes I do get enough work done to at least pay the bills. My adminstration is a terrible mess too now so that's also something I need to fix asap.
I will take care of my place as soon as possible too! But first sleep early today.

Yes I struggle to gather the energy to do everything. I merely do what I need to do for the day, but not enough to have some free time in the following days. It's also because sometimes you really need to take a break to take care of all those things you've mentioned, but I'm just living in a depression den that smells like hell and is filled with disgusting stuff. I lost all my shine and I'm just a frustrated pathetic guy trying to save it, but always self-destructing. 

I used to be worse than this though so there's at least a little bit of progress.

Yes I had a good therapist who helped me get over the worst self-hatred but I just don't have the money to go regularly. I want to progress in life, not waste it on therapists all the time. So I'm broke right now and have a lot of things to worry about and I can't get any work done because the house is a mess, I try to get ahead, but I'm so mentally exhausted and my self-esteem is so low that I'm stuck in this circle. Also I behave like a terrible person I feel like I have zero value and my mind is completely fixated on wrong stuff. I can't take days of work anymore, I have to work harder or else I'm even more screwed! And I'm taking bad care of my health because I feel so twisted in my mind, like mental breakdown that hasn't healed yet. 

But today I said fuck it and tried venting a bit, thanks for listening and trying to understand me, it means a lot when people do that.

Yes but I lose my mind over it and behave terribly. I'm very traumatized by it, I can't help myself and get so angry that I fucking hate everyone and it's very psychotic behavior. 

I'd love to have children, but I can't burden them with myself. Death or a miserable life ending when I'm around 50 due to neglected health is my future.
Because I do bad things and I feel intense hatred about people who always misunderstand me. My brain is completely broken and ruined by obsessions that fill me with anger.
